briefings.title: David Sacks: The Real AI Danger Is an AI Overlord | TomorrowX Summit.

people.name: Antonio Gracias
people.role: Founder, CEO and CIO, Valor Equity Partners

briefings.tldr: David Sacks, former White House AI Czar, and Antonio Gracias, Founder, CEO, and CIO of Valor Equity Partners, discuss how the Trump administration's pro-competition policies sparked a massive U.S. AI boom—creating roughly 1 million jobs—and warn that the real existential threat is not rogue AI, but a monopoly or duopoly "AI overlord" working hand-in-glove with a heavy-handed federal regulator.

briefings.title: Elon Musk on Why the Future Should Make You Glad to Be Alive | TomorrowX Summit
briefings.tldr: Closing Day Two of the TomorrowX Summit from China alongside Atreides' Gavin Baker and Valor Equity Partners' Antonio Gracias, Elon Musk detailed how Starship's first ship catch unlocks a 100x reduction in space access costs, while outlining aggressive scaling across xAI's rewritten C/C++ training stack, Tesla's Optimus and Cybercab rollouts, the 100-million-square-foot TerraFab, and 0.5 GW/month AI compute deployment.

briefings.title: Retail, AI and the American Dream | Gavin Baker, Antonio Gracias & Ron Biscardi | TomorrowX Summit
briefings.tldr: TomorrowX Summit launched at Austin's Moody Center to bridge the gap between retail investors (FinX, Substack, Reddit) and AI management teams, arguing that retail is now the most powerful force in the market.
